author: EmuCore - Hub
title: OutRun 2 Recomp Out NOW! OutRun Online Arcade Xbox 360 Recomp
summary: Video Game Esoterica covers the release of an Xbox 360 recompilation project for OutRun Online Arcade, effectively bringing OutRun 2 to PC through static recompilation.

blocks.text: The video announces the availability of a new recompilation project targeting the Xbox 360 version of OutRun Online Arcade, which contains OutRun 2 and its SP update. Hosted on GitHub by developer darkuni, the recomp translates the original PowerPC executable into native x86-64 code, allowing the game to run on Windows without an emulator. This approach differs from traditional emulation by converting instructions ahead of time, potentially reducing overhead and improving compatibility with modern input and display APIs.

Players interested in preserving or revisiting the Xbox 360 arcade release may benefit from the recompilation's ability to run at higher resolutions and frame rates without the configuration complexity of a full-system emulator. Results will vary depending on host hardware and the specific build used. Claims about performance or feature parity reflect the creator's own testing and are not independently verified by the Hub. Users must supply their own legally obtained game files and any required system libraries to run the recompiled binary.
